description: Pre-order pickup from Tsideh pop-ups and book Tsideh to cater your gathering.

catering.blurb: From an intimate family table to a 300-guest gathering, we bring the kitchen to you. Tell us about your event and we'll come back with a menu and quote within 48 hours. Most of our menu is naturally gluten-free and plant-forward. Tell us about allergies or dietary needs — there's never an extra charge.
